extraction.name: OWSM v4 Cleaned YODAS Dataset
extraction.description: A cleaned subset of the YODAS dataset produced via a scalable data-cleaning pipeline (resegmentation, LID-based filtering, and CTC-score-based filtering), yielding 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages. It is used to train the OWSM v4 series of open speech foundation models supporting multilingual ASR, speech translation, and language identification.
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe (Carnegie Mellon University; Honda Research Institute Japan)
extraction.citeAs: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe, "OWSM v4: Improving Open Whisper-Style Speech Models via Data Scaling and Cleaning," Interspeech 2025, doi:10.21437/Interspeech.2025-1062
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is derived from YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset. The raw YODAS data (370k hours, 149 languages) was processed through a three-step cleaning pipeline: (1) resegmentation using CTC segmentation to realign audio and text and split into ≤30s utterances, (2) LID-based filtering to remove utterances with incorrect language labels, and (3) CTC-score-based filtering to remove low-quality audio-text alignments, resulting in 166k hours across 75 languages.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: YODAS (YouTube-Oriented Dataset for Audio and Speech), a large-scale web-crawled dataset containing 370k hours of audio in 149 languages with unsegmented long-form audio recordings and text transcriptions annotated with start and end timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Three-step pipeline: (1) Resegmentation — CTC segmentation using OWSM-CTC v3.2 to realign audio and text, split into ≤30s utterances, remove non-speech segments (e.g., music), yielding 345k hours across 83 languages. (2) LID-based filtering — retain only utterances where the original language label matches both text-based LID (fastText) and audio-based LID (ECAPA-TDNN/SpeechBrain), yielding 284k hours across 75 languages. (3) CTC-score-based filtering — discard long-form utterances containing any short utterance in the lowest θCTC=0.10 quantile per language, yielding 166k hours across 75 languages.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Transcriptions and timestamps were originally provided by YODAS (sourced from YouTube). The cleaning pipeline realigns audio and text using CTC segmentation and filters based on language identification and CTC confidence scores to improve annotation quality.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: CTC confidence scores are used to quantify alignment quality between audio and text. Scores are language-dependent; utterances are ranked within each language and a relative threshold (quantile) θCTC=0.10 is applied. Experiments fine-tuning OWSM v3.1 small at varying thresholds showed that no filtering (θCTC=0.00) leads to very high WERs (>100%) due to misalignment, while θCTC=0.10 retains the majority of data with generally good performance.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: OWSM-CTC v3.2 (for CTC segmentation and confidence scoring); fastText (text-based LID); ECAPA-TDNN via SpeechBrain (audio-based LID)
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The cleaned YODAS data, data-cleaning scripts, pre-trained model weights, training code, and training logs will be publicly released via the ESPnet toolkit.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The language distribution in the cleaned YODAS data is highly imbalanced, similar to the raw YODAS data. English constitutes the largest share, while many other languages remain underrepresented. No resampling was applied.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The raw YODAS data contains incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments. The OWSM-CTC v3.2 model used for resegmentation supports only a subset of the languages present in YODAS, limiting coverage. The language distribution is highly imbalanced with English dominating.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and fine-tuning speech foundation models for multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR), speech translation (ST), and language identification (LID). The dataset is used to train the OWSM v4 series of models.

However, these timestamps can be inaccurate. Consequently, our first step is to realign the audio and text using the CTC segmentation algorithm.

rai:dataBiases.evidence: Similar to the raw YODAS data, the distribution across languages is highly imbalanced. rai:dataLimitations.evidence: The raw YODAS data has not undergone a rigorous cleaning process and may contain annotation errors.
